name: TF Health Watchdog — auto-restart + Discord alert

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const ts = Math.floor(Date.now()/1000); const reason = 'watchdog_3_consecutive_fails'; const crypto = require('crypto'); const sig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', $env.ADMIN_RESTART_HMAC_SECRET || 'unset').update(`${ts}:${reason}`).digest('hex'); return JSON.stringify({timestamp: ts, reason, _sig_for_header_below: sig}); })() }}
